task2_binary_hardware.CAMERA_ACQUISITION: Real-time hardware camera sensor allocation occurred (HAL opened session).
task2_binary_hardware.NO_CAMERA_CONTROL: No hardware camera session granted (permission denied, control condition, or non-access probe).

task3_three_tier_policy.LEGITIMATE: User-correlated, expected foreground interaction (normal app launch, user triggered camera).
task3_three_tier_policy.AMBIGUOUS: Uncorrelated, background, or unassisted access attempt requiring inspection/escalation.
task3_three_tier_policy.CONTROLS: Baseline negative controls and denied non-acquisition probes.
